$Classic Controller
*By quatric
*Super Mario Galaxy (Europe) (RMGP01)
*Play with a Classic Controller plugged into the Wii Remote: left stick moves Mario, right stick controls the Star Pointer.
*A jump, B back/shoot, X/Y spin attack, ZL crouch/ground pound, L center camera, R shoot star bit, + pause.
* CC low-memory routine at 0x800009B0

$GameCube controller
*By quatric
*Super Mario Galaxy (Europe) (RMGP01)
*Play with a GameCube controller in port 1 (no Wii Remote needed):
*Control Stick moves Mario, C-Stick controls Star Pointer, A jump, B back/shoot, X/Y spin attack, Z crouch/ground pound, L center camera, R shoot star bit, Start pause.
* KPAD sampling callback: GameCube pad -> Classic Controller sample
